name: rosetta-colour-pinstripe-display
code:
use Raster.IMAGE

let stripes = [
    (red = 0ub, green = 0ub, blue = 0ub),
    (red = 255ub, green = 0ub, blue = 0ub),
    (red = 0ub, green = 255ub, blue = 0ub),
    (red = 0ub, green = 0ub, blue = 255ub),
    (red = 255ub, green = 0ub, blue = 255ub),
    (red = 0ub, green = 255ub, blue = 255ub),
    (red = 255ub, green = 255ub, blue = 0ub),
    (red = 255ub, green = 255ub, blue = 255ub)
]

let width = 640
let height = 400

let image = IMAGE(width, height)

for y in 0..height do
    let band = y * 4 / height + 1

    for x in 0..width do
        let stripe = stripes[x / band % stripes.count]

        image.set_pixel(x, y, stripe.red, stripe.green, stripe.blue)
    od
od

image.write("pinstripe.png")

image.show("pinstripe.png")
